**Lands in:** `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` — the `SPELLINGS` self-test harness (one hint per entry today). Rationale: the file's own docblock licenses a recorded spelling only when something re-measures it; five `DECLARED-NARROWER` rows have no re-measurement because the harness cannot hold a multi-hint spelling. Verdicts are not wrong today, so p3; the remedy is the narrow one the card sketches — let a `SPELLINGS` entry carry a list of segment arrays and ask `holds` of the union — and nothing else. ⛔ Not a gate weakening, not a new gate.

Size/model suggestion: S mechanical (harness extension + the five rows), `sonnet`/`opus`; the pin loop is the proof — every added row must fail red when its declaration is edited away.

- **File surface:** `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` ONLY — (a) the `SPELLINGS` map: an entry may carry a LIST of segment arrays instead of one; (b) the pin loop in `--self-test` (LIVE / PRECISE / COMPLETE / NARROWING) asks `holds` of the union of the entry's hints; (c) the five `DECLARED-NARROWER` rows the card names (`check:logger-receiver-detach SCAN_ROOTS packages` / `examples` / `apps`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads SCAN_ROOT packages`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority SCRIPTS_DIR scripts`) gain a `spelling:` naming a new multi-hint entry, and the sentence in their `why` prose that records the one-hint omission is rewritten to match; (d) the docblock sentences that state the one-hint limitation. ⛔ No verdict changes; ⛔ no gate is weakened and none added; ⛔ no edit to any gate under `scripts/check-*.mjs` — their declarations are read, not written.
- **Premise re-verified on `origin/main` `e5812fa43`:** `SPELLINGS` (`bare-root-worklist.mjs:261–308`) holds exactly one `segments` array per entry, and the pin loop (`:1116–:1135`) destructures `{ segments, claim, holds }` and joins a single hint; the five rows (`:319–:413`) carry no `spelling:` and the `:428` prose says so in as many words ("SPELLINGS holds ONE hint per entry and this population needs one per extension"). The three gates' declarations on the same ref: `check-logger-receiver-detach.mjs:168–172` (six hints), `check-dual-build-cjs-loads.mjs:271` (`packages/**/package.json`, `packages/**/tsup.config.ts`), `check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs:182` (`scripts/*.mjs`, `scripts/*.mts`). Premise holds.
- **Container & model:** subagent lane (S), sonnet — the triage's suggestion.
- **Clause ②:** not reached — a self-test pin harness; no contract, no gate verdict changes.
- **Serial constraints:** `scripts/pm/**` is excluded from #13798 batch 1 by that claim's file surface; no other in-flight card of this seat edits `bare-root-worklist.mjs`. The proof the triage names is binding: every added multi-hint row must be shown to fail red when its declaration is edited away (temporary edit, quoted verdict, reverted).
